title: Tarwen of the Silver Star
type: Silver Star host in Fein Uaill
dek: The host who welcomes the company to its castle and presents mortal ascension as a shared ambition.
body:
A castle offered to newcomers

Tarwen welcomes Elenia, Adelia, Draygar, Krone and Olokun to an old castle among wheat fields and vineyards. When Draygar questions whether it is really theirs, Tarwen confirms the gift and presents it as an example of mortal generosity. He says servant mages can take them by teleportation circle to Zarathis, and leaves them time to speak privately.

His account of ascension

Asked by Elenia how ascension works, Tarwen urges daily improvement and cooperation, so mortals rather than gods become masters of creation. These are his convictions and his account of the society, rather than proof of what every resident believes. On returning, he offers to show the company the proving grounds, where he says warriors gain stature. His welcome establishes a guide’s role; it does not establish his rank, ancestry or authority over all Fein Uaill.
